QuestInfo.name: Stolen Child 1
QuestInfo.0: Meet #b#p2154002##k in #bVerne Mine#k at #bEdelstein#k. What kind of person steals a child like this?!
QuestInfo.1: #p2154002# says the kid is in the #broom to the left#k. Once you have the kid back, you can show #rLe Tierre#k what you do to kidnappers...
QuestInfo.2: The kid inside was a human from Edelstein, not an Elf. You sent the kid home, and #p2154002# said it was just a joke.

0.0: Mercedes... You're as beautiful as I've heard. Your face is a welcome relief from the dirty little urchins who work the mine. \r\n#L0##bSilence! Return the Elf child!#l\n#k
0.1: Ooh, are you going to attack me? You're SO scary! All I'm doing here is keeping an eye on the kid. It's not like I took the kid here myself. If you're that eager, check in the room to the left.

1.0: That was quick.\r\n#L0##bI'm looking for the Elf child! Why do you even have a human child here, too?#l\n#k
1.1: Oh? That was the other one? Honestly, I can't keep track of all the kids we steal...\r\n#L0##bWhere is the Elf child? Tell me!#l\n#k
1.2: Lighten up! I'm just having some fun.

default.0: The kid you're looking for is in the room to the left. Well, go on, then!
